verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs describe scoped API keys that restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox. A separate Permissions feature restricts what an API key can do, so it directly delivers least-privilege credentials for agents. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the permission granularity (which actions can be allowed or denied), the key creation/revocation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Scoped API keys restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox.
`Permissions` let you restrict what an API key can do.
create a Pod per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.
